name: DescribedContentIdentity
criterion: A registered payload or externally held payload can be distinguished from the associated Information Unit and from other payloads.

name: ContentFormatDeclared
criterion: The available type, format and representation details are recorded accurately where supplied or established.

name: ContentProvenanceRetained
criterion: The content registration preserves available source, origin and provenance references.

name: DescriptiveMetadataBound
criterion: Descriptive metadata can be retrieved without retrieving the full binary content.

name: RegistrationExceptionsExplicit
criterion: Unsupported, incomplete or inconsistent registration requests have explicit outcomes.

name: AssociationTargetCorrect
criterion: A governed Information Unit association resolves to the intended binary content identity.

name: MultiplePayloadAssociation
criterion: An information item may explicitly reference multiple associated payloads where its defined semantics require them.

name: VersionAssociationTraceable
criterion: An association identifies the applicable logical information version and appropriate binary-content version or standing.

name: RelationshipChangeGoverned
criterion: Creating, changing or retiring an association is authorised and attributable.

name: AssociationIntegrityDetectable
criterion: Missing, mismatched or contradictory payload associations are detected or explicitly reported.

name: CustodyKindKnown
criterion: Harmonia-managed and externally managed physical custody are distinguishable.

name: ExternalContentNoForcedCopy
criterion: A valid externally managed item can be governed and referenced without requiring automatic replication into Harmonia.

name: PhysicalLocationIndependent
criterion: Logical references remain stable through authorised storage-provider or physical-location changes.

name: CustodyAvailabilityQualified
criterion: Provider unavailability, known absence and broken reference are reported as distinct cases.

name: SourceAuthorityPreserved
criterion: Binary-content management does not imply ownership of originating clinical facts or the external source repository.

name: ThresholdPolicyApplied
criterion: Content above the release-defined large-content threshold follows the designated media path.

name: ReferenceCreatedOnAcceptedIngest
criterion: Where physical custody is accepted, a governed content reference is established and correlated to the accepted payload.

name: IngestOutcomeUnambiguous
criterion: Accepted, rejected, incomplete and indeterminate acquisition or storage outcomes are distinguishable.

name: PayloadByteIntegrityChecked
criterion: Accepted physical content can be verified against the applicable integrity evidence.

name: UncommittedMediaNotPublished
criterion: Uncertain or incomplete content capture is not misrepresented as authoritative available content.

name: AuthorisedRetrievalOnly
criterion: Permitted and denied retrievals respect the applicable effective identity and information-protection rules.

name: ReferenceBasedAcquisition
criterion: Consumers can acquire the content through a governed reference independently of Information Unit structural data retrieval.

name: ResourceBoundedTransfer
criterion: Large-content retrieval can be delivered without unbounded application memory demand under a stated performance contract.

name: AvailabilityFailureQualified
criterion: Missing, inaccessible, corrupted and temporarily unavailable content produce distinguishable outcomes.

name: TransferIntegrityAssessed
criterion: Received bytes can be verified against the expected governed content identity and integrity evidence.

name: AssemblySourcesTraceable
criterion: The payload sources and transformations contributing to assembled content remain attributable.

name: MultiPartAssemblyCorrect
criterion: Supported multi-payload content is assembled in the defined order and structure.

name: SourceAuthorityNotRewritten
criterion: Assembly does not silently change the authoritative status of source information.

name: PartialAssemblyNotMisrepresented
criterion: Missing or rejected assembly components do not produce a falsely complete result.

name: AssemblyDisclosureConstrained
criterion: An assembled result is released only when all applicable disclosure obligations are satisfied.

name: MediaRetentionRespected
criterion: Applicable retention constraints and holds are preserved by the managed content arrangement.

name: MediaReferenceRetained
criterion: Valid media references remain resolvable or explicitly dispositioned across archive, relocation and provider changes.

name: MediaVersionSemanticsExplicit
criterion: Replacement, new representation and version changes do not silently rewrite prior source identity.

name: MediaRetirementGoverned
criterion: Content retirement and deletion are prohibited when retention or external custody constraints disallow them.

name: MediaRecoveryAccountable
criterion: Recovery/restoration exercises verify consistency between metadata, governed references and available physical payloads.

name: ProtectionContextCarried
criterion: Information labels, relevant authorisation context and disclosure constraints accompany applicable media access.

name: MediaAccessAuditable
criterion: Material retrieval, disclosure and governed lifecycle changes are represented in the applicable audit/provenance framework.

name: PlatformStorageIntegrationQualified
criterion: Unavailable, degraded and restored media providers are observable through explicit application/technical status interfaces.

name: NoGenericDatabaseFallback
criterion: Large media is not silently redirected to ordinary structured Information Unit persistence when its configured media facility is unavailable.

name: TechnicalSubstitutionIndependent
criterion: Changing the underlying repository or storage technology does not redefine governed media identities or consumer contract semantics.
